## Featured Projects & Benchmarks
- **Telco Customer Churn MLOps Platform**: Production-ready MLOps system featuring **0.847 ROC-AUC**, recall improved from **48% → 80%** through threshold tuning, automated CI/CD, MLflow experiment tracking, Docker/Kubernetes deployment, and drift-aware retraining. Live Demo: https://telco-churn-mlops.streamlit.app/ | Repository: https://github.com/aakash1552005/telco-churn-mlops
- **TN Government AI Scheme Assistant (TNGov-AI-Assistant)**: Bilingual (English/Tamil) RAG assistant for citizen welfare scheme discovery achieving **86/86 validation tests passed**, 1,420 chunks across 37+ schemes, and **100% pass rate on a 50-query benchmark** using Groq LLaMA 3.3, ChromaDB, and FastAPI. Live Demo: https://tn-gov-ai-assistant.vercel.app/ | Repository: https://github.com/aakash1552005/TNGov-AI-Assistant
- **rerunner**: Deterministic flight recorder, $0 CI replay engine, and time-travel debugger for AI agents with **114 unit/integration tests passing at 100%**, dual-mode zero-dependency JSONL/SQLite transport, and under 0.5ms recording overhead. Repository: https://github.com/aakash1552005/rerunner
- **Autonomous Data Analyst (ADA)**: Enterprise-grade multi-agent tabular intelligence and AutoML system orchestrating **7 specialized autonomous agents**, delivering **100% verified numerical grounding**, zero arbitrary code execution, automated executive PDF/PPTX reports in under 25s, and a **590-test suite passing at 100%**. Live Cloud Demo: https://autonomous--data--analyst.streamlit.app/ | Repository: https://github.com/aakash1552005/Autonomous-Data-Analyst
